name: List
description: Stacks items down the page with bullets, numbers or icons, or as interactive 32px rows.
propsSummary: marker: none|disc|icon (default: disc on ul, numbers on ol)

as.description: List element. An ol numbers its items; a ul draws a bullet.

marker.description: Marker before each item, when it is not the default for `as`

when: Steps, instructions, or anything with an order
A stack of pages, files or settings to pick from (List.Row)
whenNot: Items open a menu of choices for a field (use Select or Combobox)
Items need their own surface (use Card in a Grid)
guidelines: Order matters? Use as="ol": the numbers come with it
Rows go in a List with marker="none" and gap="none"; one row per destination, the one you are on `selected`
Row meta is a short fact (a count, a path, a time); it sits in ink 3 at the end of the row
Keep one icon meaning per list — mixing icons reads as noise
Write items in parallel grammar; scanning depends on it
accessibility: Real ul/ol markup means screen readers announce the item count
Icons are decorative — the text has to carry the meaning
A selected row carries aria-current (or your own aria-current/aria-pressed), never colour alone
List.Row renders a button; pass render={<a href />} for navigation

examples.name: Bullet List
examples.description: The default marker — reach for it when order does not matter.

examples.name: Numbered List
examples.description: as="ol" makes the sequence real and draws the numbers.
examples.code:
<List as="ol">
  <List.Item>Create your account</List.Item>
  <List.Item>Configure your settings</List.Item>
  <List.Item>Start building</List.Item>
</List>

examples.name: Icon List
examples.description: Each item takes its own glyph in the marker column, in ink 3.
examples.code:
<List marker="icon">
  <List.Item icon={<Check weight="bold" />}>Unlimited projects</List.Item>
  <List.Item icon={<Check weight="bold" />}>Priority support</List.Item>
  <List.Item icon={<Check weight="bold" />}>Advanced analytics</List.Item>
</List>

examples.name: Rows
examples.description: Interactive 32px rows: a leading glyph, the label, trailing meta, the current row marked.
examples.code:
import { House, Gear, CreditCard } from "@phosphor-icons/react";

<List marker="none" gap="none" aria-label="Pages">
  <List.Row icon={<House />} meta="/" selected>
    Home
  </List.Row>
  <List.Row icon={<Gear />} meta="/settings">
    Settings
  </List.Row>
  <List.Row icon={<CreditCard />} meta="/billing">
    Billing
  </List.Row>
</List>

examples.name: Link Rows
examples.code:
<List marker="none" gap="none" aria-label="Docs">
  <List.Row render={<a href="/docs/start" />} aria-current="page" selected>
    Getting started
  </List.Row>
  <List.Row render={<a href="/docs/theming" />}>Theming</List.Row>
</List>

examples.name: No Style
examples.description: No markers: a plain stack of items.

relations.note: Use Icon as List.Item or List.Row icon
Use Stack for non-semantic vertical lists and larger rhythm
Use Sidebar.Item for the app's own navigation

propsSummary: as: ul|ol - list element; ol numbers its items
marker: none|disc|icon - marker before each item
List.Row: icon, meta, selected, render, disabled - an interactive 32px row
